title: Northbeam TechWorks Counter Ledger: The Charges a Desk Settlement Covers
content:
Which charges on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job a desk settlement covers turns on whether any payment has already been received against the job and on how many attendances the job carries labour for.

**Where a payment has already been received on the job and the job carries labour for two or more attendances**, only the charges booked for the day the crew was last sent out are covered.

**Where no payment has been received on the job**, every charge standing on the job is covered.

**Where neither of those situations holds**, the charges covered are every charge standing on the job less the payments already received against it.

## The three readings

| Payments received on the job | Attendances the job carries labour for | The charges covered |
| --- | --- | --- |
| at least one | two or more | the charges booked for the day the crew was last sent out |
| none | any | every charge standing on the job |
| at least one | one | every charge standing on the job less the payments already received |

The charges counted for the first reading are every charge booked for the day the crew was last sent out, whatever kind of charge each one is — labour, parts or a fee — and not the labour of that day alone.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**No payment received.** A hypothetical job carries 1,042.60 USD of charges in all and no payment has been received against it. The second reading governs, and the charges covered are the whole 1,042.60 USD.

**A payment received, one labour entry.** A job carrying 1,042.60 USD of charges and a single labour entry, against which 174.00 USD has been received, falls under the third reading: 1,042.60 less 174.00, which is 868.60 USD.

**A payment received, three labour entries.** The same 1,042.60 USD of charges, of which 388.20 USD is booked for the day the crew was last sent out, with 174.00 USD received and labour standing for three attendances. The first reading governs, and the charges covered are 388.20 USD.
